how: California outlawed bullfighting in 1957; only bloodless Portuguese-style bullfights are allowed at religious festivals in the Central Valley (for example around Thornton), roughly 130-150 km and 2 hours east, May to October.
No developed or open caves in the Bay Area; the nearest guided cave and spelunking tours are at Moaning Cavern in the Sierra Nevada foothills (Calaveras County), roughly 3 hours' drive east.
